styleLock.direction: clean technical athleisure commerce with a commuter tailoring edge
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF sweep for packshots, pale cast-stone info panels #EDEAE4 and #C9C6C0 for callout and variant screens, real timber deck and city stone for lifestyle frames, one material per shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-balanced key at 5600K with bounce fill, low contrast, skimming side light only on texture macros, always one soft contact shadow that grounds the hem
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte technical-knit garment surface with visible topstitch against hard stone, timber and concrete grounds; no glossy or latex finish anywhere
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif, labels set as short right-aligned callouts on hairline leader rules, never dense body copy
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight line only: dashed outline traces and leader rules, small dots in the accent colour, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: figure always cropped from the collarbone or ribcage down so no face appears, stable straight-on or slight 3/4 silhouette scale, wide-leg hem break readable in every frame, hand only when it shows a pocket or the waistband
noDrift: no glossy or shrink-wrapped fabric rendering
no visible face or model likeness
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent technical athleisure commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of paper-white seamless ground #FFFFFF, pale cast-stone info panel #EDEAE4, deep ink-charcoal text and dark garment tone #22252A, and one sage-green accent #7C9A82; neutral-cool daylight-balanced studio light at 5600K; one modern geometric sans-serif; hairline single-weight line icons, dashed outline traces and leader rules only; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; matte technical-knit surface with true drape and visible topstitch, never glossy or shrink-wrapped; figure cropped from the collarbone or ribcage down with no face; stable silhouette scale and hem break; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy latex fabric.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 纯白棚拍半身裁切主图，一手插侧袋、赤足垂坠阔腿；002 咖啡座外摆双人（灰与浅米两色）；003 木露台持瑜伽垫单人逆光；004 白底左侧穿图、右侧三条引线标注（面料类主张与成分字样）；005 编号 01/02/03 三格结构条（侧袋与假门襟虚线框、手拉弹力腰头、假后袋）；006 城市石廊街角戴帽全身步态；007 水泥墙前双色背靠站立。品类判定：以图为准，功能诉求集中在弹力腰头、速干针织、口袋收纳与运动后直连街头的穿法，故归运动户外/服饰而非女装下装；源类目提示与判定不冲突处未改判。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、全部模特面容与身份（一律改为颈部或肋骨以下裁切）、004/005 图内英文原句与成分字样（改为卖点与标注占位符承载）、006 上衣印花字与沿街店铺字样、原平台店铺字样与任何徽标水印。未写入任何实测数据、成分比例或资质，一律以占位与空心证框架承载。
